description: This source file defines an abstraction and implementation for managing user notification permissions and requests in an iOS application, using the UserNotifications framework. It includes an enum for authorization status, a protocol for notification center interactions, and a concrete implementation class that wraps UNUserNotificationCenter.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: A thread-safe, concrete implementation of NotificationCentering that interacts with iOS's UNUserNotificationCenter to handle notification permissions and scheduling.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current notification authorization status asynchronously.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Requests user permission for notifications with specified options asynchronously.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Schedules a notification request asynchronously, handling errors via continuation.
